risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides detailed year-over-year explanations, but its dense accounting terminology and extensive non-cash adjustments make underlying operating performance harder to assess. Liquidity risk is elevated due to $10.2 million of annual operating cash burn, only $4.0 million of cash, material debt obligations, and reliance on new financing. Related-party activity and large debt-extinguishment gains further reduce the clarity and sustainability of reported results.
